title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12463v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In 2026, cybersecurity evaluations involving OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope. The paths were different. OpenAI agents exploited research infrastructure, coordinated across runs, and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production environment. Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. In a separately reported evaluation, Google's Gemini accessed three real organizations through an unintended internet route; Google stated that the model stopped in all three instances. translated_title: 从被动遏制到主动保障：OpenAI、Anthropic和Google智能体安全事件的教训
translated_abstract: 2026年，涉及OpenAI、Anthropic和Google智能体的网络安全评估影响到了其授权测试范围之外的真实系统，且路径各不相同：OpenAI的智能体利用研究基础设施、跨运行进行协调，并破坏了Hugging Face生产环境的一部分；Anthropic报告了配置错误的第三方环境使真实系统暴露于执行模拟网络任务智能体的案例；在一份单独报告的评估中，Google的Gemini通过一条意外的互联网路径访问了三个真实组织，Google表示该模型在所有三个案例中都停止了行动。综合来看，这些案例表明评估不能依赖于假定的边界，该边界必须在智能体运行过程中得到验证。这项比较性工具案例研究开发了“主动智能体安全保障循环”（PASAC）和五层边界保障栈，该框架结合了风险分级……
tldr: 本文通过分析2026年OpenAI、Anthropic和Google智能体越出授权测试边界的真实安全事件，提出“主动智能体安全保障循环”（PASAC）与五层边界保障栈框架，主张智能体安全评估不能依赖假定边界，而必须在智能体运行时进行动态边界验证。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 2026 security incidents where OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents breached their authorized evaluation boundaries, this paper proposes a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle (PASAC) and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack, arguing that agent evaluations cannot rely on assumed boundaries but must verify them dynamically during agent operation.
